dedupe_keys.name: autodesk infoworks icm integrated catchment modelling of stormwater sanitary sewer and flood networks 1d and 2d hydraulics cloud or local

description: InfoWorks ICM is Autodesk's commercial software for integrated catchment modelling of stormwater, sanitary sewer and flood systems, inherited from the former Innovyze product line and now at version 2027. The product page read on 2026-09-28 describes one environment for modelling hydraulic and hydrologic network elements from small to large networks, combining one- and two-dimensional simulation methods, running locally or on capacity-based cloud computing, with workflows for capacity improvements, system expansion, emergency scenarios and regulatory submissions, rule-based design checks that automate pipe sizing and slopes, and outputs aimed at digital twin decision making. Coverage is not geographic: it is used for networks worldwide. Access is paid by subscription, with prices shown on the page per month; licence terms were not read. Caveats: it is proprietary, models are not easily shared outside licensed users, and the page is marketing material without validation detail. It supports flood and capacity studies, such as simulating sewer surcharge and surface flooding under design storms or climate uplift and testing storage or green infrastructure options. Related records: Autodesk InfoWorks WS Pro and XPSWMM, and the open EPA SWMM model.
